name: King Mukla
guide_text: Use your bananas early game on a good unit to save HP in the earlygame and then play normally from there. If you don't find a good unit on turn 1, you should use all of them turn 3 the latest.
buddy_guide_text: This buddy is extremely mediocre. Don't play into it too hard, sell it when you want to stabilize.
